scripts.dev: npm run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply ACCOUNTS --local --config server/wrangler.jsonc && wrangler dev --config server/wrangler.jsonc
scripts.test: npm run build && vitest run --config server/vitest.public.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright test --config test/e2e/playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:public: npm run build && playwright test --config test/e2e/public.playwright.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:speech-real: E2E_REAL_SPEECH=1 npm run test:e2e -- --grep 'pinned Cactus WASM'
scripts.test:e2e:all: npm run test:e2e && npm run test:tts
